ideas.title: Investigating the Minnesota Medicaid Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of fraud and abuse in Minnesota's Medicaid program, including the potential causes and consequences of the scandal.
questions: What are the allegations of fraud and abuse in Minnesota's Medicaid program?
How much money is potentially lost due to the scandal?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and waste in a critical government program. By following the money and examining public records, we can shed light on the scandal and hold those responsible accountable.
